name: Rosemary bread rolls
title: Bread rolls

steps.text: 800g strong flour, yeast, pinch of salt, 500ml warm water: blitz.
Roll into balls onto greaseproof paper; leave for an hour.
Dress with rosemary and olive oil; in for 30 min.
